A.note: Wide establishing view with the rock, runway, bay and dense town. The sky is believable and the water has texture and a horizon haze. The foreground is flat grey tarmac. The white block buildings and the flat green patches look like game assets. The rock has the best rock texture of the three.

B.note: Lower, closer angle, so the runway reads better, but the rock is cropped and the sky is lost. There is a neon-green flat grass slab in the middle. The water has hard white outline shapes that look like a vector overlay. The terracotta town is dense but looks like tiled blocks. The cruise ship is a nice touch.

C.note: Nearly the same frame as A. The water is a flatter, more saturated blue and the distant landmass has a hard, mirror-like edge, which reads as a render artifact. The foreground is as flat and block-like as in A.

why: A and C share the strongest composition, with the rock, sky and scale all in frame, and A has the more natural water and horizon. B loses the sky, crops the rock and has artificial-looking water outlines and a slab of green.
top_fix_for_best: Texture the foreground tarmac and the white block buildings with weathering, roof detail and shadows. Add vehicles, aircraft and trees for scale, and break up the flat green patches with varied vegetation.
